chunk_findings.detail: The exemption returns None from the basename alone (`ddflow-`, `.merge-`, `.version-`) and never checks the comment’s own criterion that scratch trees live in the system temp dir (or any other scratch_tree marker). Given package_parent() `[REDACTED:path]` — a linked worktree of another lane’s unmerged branch, not a ci scratch tree — `foreign_launch_root()` now returns None and the import is treated as legitimate. That is the case the guard exists to reject; the prefix is also the natural name for ordinary ddflow worktrees, so the fix re-opens the hole for any foreign checkout that happens to be named like ci’s scratch dirs. The new test only builds `checkout[1].parent / "ddflow-ci.abc123"` and asserts None, so it locks in the over-broad bypass and would not fail on that input.

That is the case the guard exists to reject; the prefix is also the natural name for ordinary ddflow worktrees, so the fix re-opens the hole for any foreign checkout that happens to be named like ci’s scratch dirs. The new test only builds `checkout[1].parent / "ddflow-ci.abc123"` and asserts None, so it locks in the over-broad bypass and would not fail on that input.
